definitions.corners: Normal-time events with subEventId=30 (corners taken, not corners awarded).
definitions.shots: Normal-time eventId=10, plus free-kick shots (33) and penalties (35).
definitions.accurateShots: Those shots carrying tag 1801 (accurate); kept as source-defined, not relabelled as operator shots on target.
definitions.yellowCards: Normal-time events with tag 1702 or 1703, counted once per player/period/time.
definitions.redCards: Normal-time events with tag 1701 or 1703; second yellow is separately recorded.
definitions.lineups: Historical, final match formation records. Not evidence of pre-match announcement time.
definitions.injuries: Not supplied. Absence from a lineup is never interpreted as an injury.
